title: Classical Hamiltonian of Reissner-Nordström black holes at second post-Minkowskian order from scattering amplitudes
summary: We employ scattering amplitudes in Einstein-Maxwell theory to compute the classical Hamiltonian of a binary system of two charged, non-spinning compact objects. The effective Hamiltonian is valid to all orders in velocity and up to second post-Minkowskian order (2PM), i.e. $\mathcal{O}(G^2)$. The classical interaction potential is extracted via matching the four-point tree and one-loop amplitudes to those of a suitably chosen classical effective field theory.
